name: 馬權威
objective: This course will introduce the mathematical principles in engineering, including following topics: First-Order ODEs, Second-Order Linear ODEs, Higher Order Linear ODEs, Systems of ODEs, Series Solutions of ODEs, and Laplace Transforms.
schedule:
1	Course introduction & Basic Concepts of First-Order ODEs.  
2	Separable ODEs & Exact ODEs. 
3	Linear ODEs & Existence and Uniqueness of Solutions for Initial Value Problems.
4	No lecture on 28 Sep (Confucius’ Birthday) & In-class Quiz 1.
5	Homogeneous Linear ODEs of Second Order & Homogeneous Linear ODEs with Constant Coefficients & Euler–Cauchy Equations. 
6	Existence and Uniqueness of Solutions & Nonhomogeneous ODEs.
7	Review of First and Second-Order ODEs & Mid-term Exam.
8	No lecture on 26 Oct (Compensatory holiday for Retrocession Day) & Higher Order Homogeneous Linear ODEs and Higher Order Homogeneous Linear ODEs with Constant Coefficients.
9	Nonhomogeneous Linear ODEs & Systems of ODEs as Models in Engineering Applications.
10	No lecture on 9 Nov (Compensatory holiday for Taipei Tech’s anniversary celebration and school fair) & Power Series Method.
11	Legendre’s Equation & Extended Power Series Method.
12	Bessel’s Equation & General Solution of Bessel Functions & In-class Quiz 2.
13	Laplace Transform & Transforms of Derivatives and Integrals & Unit Step Function.
14	Differentiation and Integration of Transforms & Systems of ODEs.
15-16	Laplace Transform: General Formulas & Final Exam & Review.
17-18	Flexible Learning.
scorePolicy:
Subject Mark = 
Attendance 10% +
In-class quizzes 1&2 25% +
Mid-term exam 25% +
Final exam 30% +
Student group practice and discussion 10%
